Animal · 2 hexes · SM +1 Giant Poisonous Snake [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: snakes; answers Giant Poisonous Snake (SRD 5.1)]

Three metres of snake carrying enough venom to kill a horse, striking from a coil faster than anyone can pull a hand back. It has no interest in a fight it cannot win by chemistry, which is why it warns first — and why the ones that do not warn are the ones that kill people.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/giant-poisonous-snake.gct
  • Independent build total: -52 points of racial traits plus 16 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Giant Poisonous Snake (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 20 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 6 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • Three metres, which is the SM +1 row.
  • Weak in ST and deliberately so. The venom is priced at 40 points as a disabling ability, and it carries almost the whole rating; a bite that did meaningful damage as well would make this creature something it is not.
  • Added after a post-hoc comparison against independent GURPS fan conversions of this creature: the Tracking skill, which a creature with Discriminatory Smell should always have. The comparison surfaced the gap; the build is still ours.
